# hls.js

Bundled version: 1.6.13, Apache-2.0. License: `hls.LICENSE`.

Upstream: https://github.com/video-dev/hls.js

Distribution: https://registry.npmjs.org/hls.js/-/hls.js-1.6.13.tgz

The archive's SHA-512 integrity was verified against the npm version metadata before copying `dist/hls.min.js`. This local copy avoids runtime CDN script dependencies. Media is fetched directly by the browser from the public CHZZK CDN. No remote player scripts are injected into the CHZZK site.
